postFreezeScan.coverage: All 108 frozen entries plus candidate-freeze.json; scan output itself excluded.

evidence.detail: Stage 8 requires fixed low-cardinality metrics and identifies pending/oldest backlog, running, retries, dead letters, unknown outcomes, and expired leases as essential metrics.
Queue statistics are sent to the log callback as a worker_cycle record.
The implementation serializes allowlisted structured log records; it provides no metrics instrument/export interface.
The health command reports only live/ready; worker stats are written to a local health file, not exposed as scrapeable metrics.

findings.scenario: An operator or monitoring system relying on the documented metrics interface has no emitted queue metrics to scrape or alert on; structured log fields and a local health file do not supply the specified metrics interface.
findings.consequence: Backlog age, retries, dead letters, unknown outcomes, and lease expiry may go unobserved, leaving a stated Stage 8 observability acceptance requirement unmet.
findings.requiredCorrectionOrGate: Provide and qualify a low-cardinality metrics emission/export path for the required worker metrics, or obtain an explicit approved contract change and update the Stage 8 evidence before reconsidering GO.

findings.type: Readiness check does not cover required worker privileges

evidence.detail: ready() checks SELECT on job, UPDATE on only job.state, INSERT on activity.entry, and SELECT on activity_source.
Worker operations also insert attempts, update multiple job columns, update outbox_delivery, and update jobs during recovery.

findings.scenario: If a grant is revoked or narrowed after deployment, ready() may still return true while dispatch, completion, heartbeat, or recovery fails on an unchecked privilege.
findings.consequence: The service can advertise readiness despite lacking privileges needed to process work.
findings.requiredCorrectionOrGate: Extend readiness qualification to cover every required table/column privilege used by worker operations, and add a privilege-drift regression.
